name: Service Desk Tier 1
description: First point of contact for general technology questions, basic troubleshooting, and requests that do not clearly belong to a specialist team.

name: ResNet (residence hall network)
description: Supports internet access and connected devices for students living in university residence halls.

name: Classroom & AV
description: Supports audio-visual equipment and video conferencing technology for teaching and meeting spaces.

name: Print Services
description: Manages campus printing, copying, and large-format output, along with the equipment and supplies behind them.

name: Identity & Access
description: Manages NSU accounts, passwords, multi-factor authentication, and permissions to campus systems.

name: LMS (Canvas)
description: Supports the Canvas learning management system and the teaching and assessment tools connected to it.

name: Lab Desktop East
description: Maintains desktop computers, software images, and peripherals in public and instructional computer labs in the East zone of campus.

name: Lab Desktop West
description: Maintains desktop computers, software images, and peripherals in public and instructional computer labs in the West zone of campus.

name: Research Computing
description: Provides high-performance computing, research data storage, and consulting for faculty and student researchers.

name: Registrar Systems
description: Supports Banner student records, registration, transcripts, and related academic records systems.

name: Financial Aid Systems
description: Supports the online systems students use to apply for, track, and receive financial aid.

name: Security & Phishing
description: Handles reports of phishing and malware and advises the campus on safe computing practices.

name: Telecom & Campus Network
description: Operates campus telephone service, network cabling, and core network infrastructure.

name: Accessibility Technology
description: Provides assistive technology and consults on accessible digital content and learning materials.
